about: How we build this list: we search the sentences in which federal appellate courts and the Supreme Court cite a case, and the cases' own text. A judgment model then reads the opinion of the court in each of the top 10 candidates. We show a case only when the model finds a passage in it that states your sentence, at confidence 0.8 or higher. We leave out cases that a later court overruled or reversed.
